01
🖥️
PC Hardware Troubleshooting & Maintenance
Problem A lab unit was failing to POST with no display output. The fault needed to be systematically isolated without access to replacement parts initially.
Solution Applied a step-by-step diagnostic process — reseating RAM, testing with minimal components, and identifying a failed GPU. Documented the full troubleshooting log as a reusable reference guide for future lab sessions.
Hardware Diagnostics POST Troubleshooting Component Testing Technical Documentation
02
🗄️
Lending System Database (MSSQL + SSIS)
Problem A lending business needed a structured way to track borrowers and loan transactions, and required a warehouse copy of the data for reporting — done manually and error-prone.
Solution Designed the SIAN_LENDING database in MS SQL Server with Borrower and Lending_Transactions tables, then built an SSIS package with a full Data Flow to automatically copy records into a separate SIAN_LENDINGWAREHOUSE for reporting and backup.
MS SQL Server SSIS ETL Database Design
